IS 4762 : 2002 : FASTENERS — WORM DRIVE HOSE CLAMPS FOR GENERAL PURPOSES — SPECIFICATIONICS 21.060.70PGD 37Reaffirmed 20211. ScopeThis standard covers the requirements of worm drive hose clamps for general purpose use in the size range from 12 mm up to and including 140 mm. Hose clamps above sizes 140 mm are used for variety of purposes including strapping.
